messages:
incident-bot: PAGE to #incidents — SEV2: High error rate for private endpoints in gcp-northamerica-northeast1 (customers on Private/VPN). Incident ID: INC-2026-0777

Leo (oncall): ack I'm taking this. pulling up dashboards.

Maria (SRE): I see route withdraws from our interconnect, BGP sessions flapping since ~12:05 UTC. Pings to customer gateways show 50% loss.

Ajay (eng-infra): Confirmed. Cloud Router is logging `BGP session reset` for peer 35.123.45.67. Looks like route suppression after repeated withdraws. Filing ticket with GCP.

Priya (support): Notifying affected customers: AcmeCorp, HealthApp. Sending initial template: 'We are investigating network instability impacting private connectivity to region gcp-northamerica-northeast1. Our teams are working on mitigation.'

Leo (oncall): Quick mitigation: can we fail traffic to public endpoints as fallback? For AcmeCorp their onprem setup allows public egress—ask CS to toggle on their side.

CSC (customer-success): AcmeCorp responded: can enable fallback within 20 minutes. HealthApp on nightly maintenance window — can't change right now. Both are using dedicated interconnects.

Ajay (eng-infra): Running quick check, here's relevant outputs:
```
$ gcloud compute routers get-status router-prod-nn1 --region=northamerica-northeast1
BGP peer 35.123.45.67: state = ESTABLISHED
lastEvent = BGP session reset
routesAdvertised = 120
routesLearned = 0
```

Maria (SRE): Also seeing DNS timeouts for private DNS zone in that VPC — queries to 169.254.x.x returning SERVFAIL intermittently. Could be control-plane replication issue compounding reachability.

Leo (oncall): Action list:
- Ajay: escalate to GCP support, include BGP logs
- Maria: start partial failover to public endpoints via routing policy (canary 10%)
- Priya/CSC: update customers and collect critical SLAs
- I'll take handoff in 30m if stabilized

Ajay (eng-infra): Escalation sent (GCP case 987654321). They suspect a fabric-level issue in the POP handling our interconnect. GCP asked for pcap if we can get it.

Maria (SRE): Started canary: updated route-policy to shift 10% of sessions to public egress via nat-gw-2. Command:
```
kubectl apply -f /deploy/routing/canary-public-egress.yaml
```
Metrics: errors down from ~37% -> ~22% on the canary path.

Priya (support): Templates sent to customers. AcmeCorp confirmed fallback toggled; their traffic shows recovery. HealthApp still impacted; asking SRE for ETA.

Leo (oncall): We're seeing partial recovery in canary. Need decision: widen to 50%? If GCP ETA > 2h, widen and invoke incident SLA play.

Maria (SRE): Recommend 50% now. Risk: increased egress cost for customers on private plans. Documenting tradeoff in incident ticket.

CSC (customer-success): Noted. Will flag for billing ops — customers notified about cost implications: 'We may route traffic via public paths temporarily, which could incur additional egress charges. We will provide detailed post-incident usage.'

Ajay (eng-infra): GCP updated: root cause suspected internal BGP reconvergence causing route withdraw storms in northamerica-northeast1. Working on control-plane fix, ETA 1.5 hours. They've asked us to keep BGP sessions active; do not restart routers.

Leo (oncall): Acknowledged. Rolling to 50% now.
```
kubectl apply -f /deploy/routing/public-egress-50pct.yaml
```

Maria (SRE): After 50% shift: overall errors down to ~6%, latency stable. HealthApp still sees 504s because their routes are pinned to interconnect with no fallback; need CS to request temporary whitelist for public fallback.

Priya (support): HealthApp agreed to temporary public fallback after internal approval; toggled. Observed recovery at 12:47 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0777 updated. Severity lowered to SEV3 (partial impact) at 12:50 UTC.

Leo (oncall): Prep for handoff. I'm stable, will hand to Maria in 40m. Maria you'll own extended mitigations and postmortem.

Maria (SRE): Roger. Collecting all logs, BGP dumps, dig/traceroute samples. Saving pcap requested by GCP. Adding notes to incident ticket.

Ajay (eng-infra): Uploading pcap to GCP case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321

Priya (support): Final customer update: most recovered, HealthApp recovered after fallback, no data lost. CS scheduled a 1:1 with top-affected customers to review options.

Leo (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated for paging. Will keep thread open until GCP confirms fix. :thumbsup:
